## Activity

During November 2019, East City Eye Clinic recorded 188 captures. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity count provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading measures and should be read alongside those results.

The monthly capture total is presented without adjustment or extrapolation. It reflects the activity included in the site report for the period and supports review of the volume of images requiring assessment.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.1. This indicates the proportion of the reported captures that could not be used for grading. The count and rate are reported together to provide both the number of affected captures and the corresponding overall measure.

## Grading

Grading identified 33 referable results during November 2019. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This measure summarises the central grading interval for the reported activity. Together, the referable-result count and the median lag provide a concise view of grading outcomes and timeliness at East City Eye Clinic.
